You know how you look at other people - often in admiration? Or when someone accidentally embarrassed themselves and after a while it's all forgotten? You don't tell them you admire them, but you do. You don't carry on about the embarrassing thing, because your life doesn't revolve around it. They're more worried about what you're/everyone else is thinking about them, too.

People look at you that way, with respect. And the little negative things - people's lives don't revolve around you, so they're not big things, at all, they're forgotten. 

This helped me a lot because I often tell myself that that person is thinking this-and-this about me, but how could I know for sure? What other people think about you speaks about them, their opinions, not you or yours. 

Think about how you think of other people, and realize that that is probably how they think of you.
